used_script:
Slide 1: Turn Your Fluent English Into Income - Start Teaching Online Today!

Slide 2: Choose Your Platform
Research popular sites like VIPKid, iTalki, and Cambly to find the best fit for you and your schedule.

Slide 3: Set Up Your Teaching Space
Create a quiet, well-lit area with a reliable internet connection and a good webcam to provide a professional experience.

Slide 4: Prepare Your Lessons
Develop engaging lesson plans tailored to different age groups and skill levels to keep students motivated and learning.

Slide 5: Gain Certification if Needed
Consider obtaining a TEFL or TESOL certification to boost your credibility and attract more students.

Slide 6: Schedule Flexibly and Manage Your Time
Set a consistent schedule that works for you and maintain good communication with your students.

Slide 7: Ready to Teach?
